name: Data.heightLe_inv_ratio
summary: Combine the height of the squared norm of the trivial lift (negative, against parallel weight) with the fit family's bound for the auxiliary pair q₂ and a family y' whose size is controlled: at each ι a test form pairs with the trivial lift to a multiple of the jet of depth_indicator_jet, so its ι-adic size is at least p^{−F(p)} times |ι V|, V a fixed root of a product of norms; the archimedean size of V is at most exp(B₀).

steps.claim: The tame characters at the chosen places are finitely many (f), m ≥ …, the chosen level is free (A), and the parts H of hE.
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨f, _, A, H, _⟩ := ofFinite (tameChars D.finite_isChosen.toFinset), D.le_m,
    D.classAut_eq_bot_of_le_chosenLevel le_rfl (card_unit.trans_le D.nat_le_of_hasLogBound), id hE

steps.claim: For each tame character χ, a flat pair q₁(χ) for Fin (2z − 20) with the tame part of χ (exists_isFlat).
steps.lean: choose _ c₁ H₁ using D.exists_isFlat (Fin (2 * p.z - 20))

steps.claim: Flat pairs for Fin 4 exist for each tame character (Z).
steps.lean: have Z := D.exists_isFlat (Fin 4)

steps.claim: A flat pair q₂ for the character χ = D.χ (Fin 4), and the number t ≠ 0 of depth_indicator_jet at the orders c_τ − z (within [w(τ), w(τ) + x^42] by the weight bounds), with its conjugate bound ht and the jet bound hd.
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨q₂, c₂, H₂⟩, t, t0, ht, hd⟩ := Z ⟨(D.χ, D.ω), D.chi_hasWeight, by simp_all⟩,
    D.depth_indicator_jet (p.c · - p.z) fun τ ↦ by
      grw [nominalWeight_le_w_sub _ j, ← @w_le_nominalWeight_add _ D j (by grind)]
      norm_cast; grind

steps.claim: For each χ a flat pair q₃(χ) for Fin 4.
steps.lean: choose _ c₃ H₃ using Z

steps.claim: From the fit family at j: γ, g, G (denominators and rank-one bounds); and V with V^{#chars} = ∏_χ intAlgPart(q₃(χ), 1)·intAlgPart(q₁(χ), 1)·t·intAlgPart(q₂, 1) (an |G|-th root exists in ℂ).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨γ, g, G⟩, V, e⟩ := o.2 j, IsAlgClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq (∏ χ, Pair.intAlgPart (H₃ χ).2
    .one * (Pair.intAlgPart (H₁ χ).2 .one * (t * q₂.intAlgPart H₂.2 .one))) f.card_pos

steps.claim: Let N be the number of classes of U(I_1) at the chosen level.
steps.lean: let N := Nat.card (StdClasses (n := Unit) D.chosenLevel)

steps.claim: At each ι (with an l-adic place), for the twist ϑ = (θ ι)^j: there is a test form Ξ with |ι(V)|·l^{−F(l)} ≤ |ι(N²·⟨Ξ, trivialLift(ϑ)⟩/q₂.ratio(ϑ))| (proved in steps 15–24).
steps.lean:
have K (l : PrimePadicIso) [PadicPlace l.1] : let ϑ := (θ l).powTwist j; ∃ Ξ,
      AuxPair.IsTestForm _ l.1 Ξ ∧ ‖ιₚ V‖ *
      l.1 ^ (-D.forcedPart l.1) ≤ ‖ιₚ (N ^ 2 * inner ℂ Ξ (Pair.trivialLift H ϑ) / q₂.ratio ϑ)‖ := ?_

steps.claim: For every σ: |σ(V)| ≤ exp(B₀): factor σ(V) by exists_factorisation_le, bound t by ht and each intAlgPart by norm_conj_intAlgPart_le, and compare on the scales.
steps.lean:
have hV (σ : ℂ ≃+* ℂ) : ‖σ V‖ ≤ exp D.B₀ := by
    choose _ _ _ h using exists_factorisation_le (σ : ℂ →+* ℂ) e 1
    simp at h; grw [h, ht]; repeat grw [norm_conj_intAlgPart_le]
    use D.le_of_hasLogBound D.lt_of_hasLogBound; all_goals apply_assumption

steps.claim: The height bound is the product of: the height of |trivialLift(1)|² (heightLe_norm_trivialLift_sq), the square of the fit family's bound for the ramified pair q₂ (o.3), and the family y'(ι) = (q₂.ratio(ϑ)/|trivialLift(ϑ)|)²/N³, whose height is witnessed by H = V·V̄, with archimedean bound exp(2B₀) from step 9 (for σ and σ∘conj), and the ℓ-adic exponents γ_l + 2F(l)·log l (steps 10.1–10.6); the result is monotone in the bound.
steps.lean:
refine (((heightLe_norm_trivialLift_sq hE).mul
    ((o.3 j q₂ 1 (by simpa [Pair.IsRamified, c₂] using D.omega_zpow_ne_one 1)).pow 2)).mul
    (y' := fun ι ↦ (q₂.ratio ((θ ι).powTwist j) / ‖Pair.trivialLift H ((θ ι).powTwist j)‖) ^ 2 /
    N ^ 3) ⟨V * star V, _, fun l ↦
    γ l + 2 • (D.forcedPart l * log l), by simpa [prod_eq_zero_iff, t0] using congr($e = 0), fun σ ↦
    exp_add .. ▸ map_mul σ .. ▸ norm_mul_le_of_le (hV σ) (hV (.trans starRingAut σ)), fun ι ↦ by
    choose Ξ b h using (@K ι ⟨(complexToCp ι.2).comp ·⟩)
    have := mul_le_mul (h 1) (h starRingAut.toRingHom) (by bound) (by bound)
    grw [exp_add, exp_nsmul, ← show ‖ι.2 (N * _)‖ ≤
      _ from ((G ι).2 p hE).rank_one_bound _ A (b 1) (b _)]
    simp [rpow_def_of_pos, ι.1.2.pos, exp_neg, ratio_ne_zero_and_real, field, -map_natCast, N,
      ← span_singleton_smul_eq (left_ne_zero_of_smul (trivialLift_ne_zero H .one)).isUnit
      (LValueData.trivialLift _), starProjection_singleton, ↓← Pair.trivialLift.eq_1] at this ⊢
    grw [this]; ring_nf; rfl, Filter.eventually_atTop.2 ⟨⌈D.x₁⌉₊, fun U hU ↦ by
    simp [dirCost, forcedPart, sum_mul, mul_sum, (filter ..).sum_comm, mul_assoc,
      D.primeSum_eq_sum_localAsk hU, (D.le_of_hasLogBound : D.nominalWeight _ ≤ D.a)]
    grw [g, (D.le_of_hasLogBound : D.x ^ 999 ≤ D.B₀)]; linarith; simp⟩⟩).mono (add_sub_cancel ..).le
    fun ι ↦ ?_

steps.claim: At ι take the test form Ξ of step 8.
steps.lean: choose Ξ b h using (@K ι ⟨(complexToCp ι.2).comp ·⟩)

steps.claim: Multiply the inequalities of step 8 for ι and for ι∘conj.
steps.lean: have := mul_le_mul (h 1) (h starRingAut.toRingHom) (by bound) (by bound)

steps.claim: Bound by the rank-one bound of the fit family (step 10.3.1).
steps.lean:
grw [exp_add, exp_nsmul, ← show ‖ι.2 (N * _)‖ ≤
      _ from ((G ι).2 p hE).rank_one_bound _ A (b 1) (b _)]

steps.claim: |ι(N·⟨Ξ, ·⟩)| is bounded by the rank-one bound of G at the test form (rank_one_bound).
steps.lean:
show ‖ι.2 (N * _)‖ ≤
      _ from ((G ι).2 p hE).rank_one_bound _ A (b 1) (b _)]

steps.claim: Simplify: real powers of l, the ratio is real and nonzero, the projection to the line of the trivial lift (starProjection_singleton).
steps.lean:
simp [rpow_def_of_pos, ι.1.2.pos, exp_neg, ratio_ne_zero_and_real, field, -map_natCast, N,
      ← span_singleton_smul_eq (left_ne_zero_of_smul (trivialLift_ne_zero H .one)).isUnit
      (LValueData.trivialLift _), starProjection_singleton, ↓← Pair.trivialLift.eq_1] at this ⊢

steps.claim: Conclude the ℓ-adic bound (ring_nf).
steps.lean: grw [this]; ring_nf; rfl

steps.claim: The sum of the exponents is eventually at most the bound: for large U, the sum over primes of the forced parts is the sum of the local asks (primeSum_eq_sum_localAsk), so α + Σ e_l ≤ … − 𝖴 (dirCost, g, x^999 ≤ B₀); the remaining identity of the families is left (fun ι ↦ ?_).
steps.lean:
, Filter.eventually_atTop.2 ⟨⌈D.x₁⌉₊, fun U hU ↦ by
    simp [dirCost, forcedPart, sum_mul, mul_sum, (filter ..).sum_comm, mul_assoc,
      D.primeSum_eq_sum_localAsk hU, (D.le_of_hasLogBound : D.nominalWeight _ ≤ D.a)]
    grw [g, (D.le_of_hasLogBound : D.x ^ 999 ≤ D.B₀)]; linarith; simp⟩⟩).mono (add_sub_cancel ..).le
    fun ι ↦ ?_

steps.claim: The ratios are nonzero and real (ratio_ne_zero_and_real).
steps.lean: have := @ratio_ne_zero_and_real

steps.lean: have := @NeZero.ne ℕ

steps.claim: The identity of families: 1/ratio = (norm of trivial lift)²·(…) by ratio_eq_intAlgPart_div and the definitions of intAlgPart and denomBound.
steps.lean: simp [ratio_eq_intAlgPart_div H, Pair.intAlgPart, denomBound, twist_one_spec, field, *]

steps.claim: Bound natural numbers ℓ-adically by 1.
steps.lean: repeat grw [norm_natCast_le_one]; simp

steps.claim: Proof of step 8: fix ϑ = (θ ι)^j and let b = (b of lValueData H ϑ)/(b of lValueData H₂.2 ϑ).
steps.lean: intro ϑ; let b := (lValueData H ϑ).auxPair.b / (lValueData H₂.2 ϑ).auxPair.b

steps.claim: Apply the jet bound hd to the modulus (ϖ̄) (D.𝔪 ϑ 1 false) and the prime l: an exponent α and x₀ with Σα = orders and p^{−F(p)} ≤ |ι(…coefficient…)|.
steps.lean:

    hd (D.𝔪 ϑ 1 false) (pow_one D.piGBar ▸ D.ideal_untwistedModulus_eq_span) _

steps.claim: Twist the kernel by a tame character ψ at a point z so that its class sum is at least as large ι-adically (exists_twisted_classSum_ge, free level A).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨z, ψ, hr⟩ := exists_twisted_classSum_ge (D.levelPlaces ϑ).chosenPlace _
    (D.finite_isChosen.mem_toFinset.2 ·.2.2.1) ιₚ (modKernel (stdSpace ..) (stdSpace ..) 1 b _
    (Pi.single x₀ 1) (.monomial α 1) ⟨1, ·⟩ 1) le_rfl le_rfl A

steps.claim: Factor ψ = ψ₃·ψ₁ with |ι V| ≤ |ι(intAlgPart(q₃(ψ₃))·intAlgPart(q₁(ψ₁))·t·intAlgPart(q₂))| (exists_factorisation_le).
steps.lean: obtain ⟨ψ₃, ψ₁, hψ, h⟩ := exists_factorisation_le ιₚ e ψ

steps.claim: The test form of exists_test_form_inner_kernelForm for q₁(ψ₁), q₂, q₃(ψ₃), the character b/ψ, x₀ and α (the characters match); it is the Ξ of step 8, with the pairing identity E.
steps.lean:
refine (exists_test_form_inner_kernelForm (H₁ ψ₁) H₂ (H₃ ψ₃) (b := b / ψ.1.1) hE ϑ (o.1 l) x₀ hα
    (by simp [b, AuxPair.b, ← hψ, c₁, c₃, twist_one_spec, div_div, mul_assoc])).imp fun Ξ ⟨E, T⟩ ↦
    ⟨T, ?_⟩

steps.claim: The class sum of 1 at the chosen level of lValueData H ϑ is N, by step 20.1.
steps.lean:
have n : stdClassSum (lValueData H ϑ).chosenLevel 1 =
    (N : ℂ) := show stdClassSum D.chosenLevel 1 = _ by simp [classSum, A, N]; rfl

steps.claim: It is the class sum of 1 at D.chosenLevel, which is N (classes with trivial stabilisers: A).
steps.lean: show stdClassSum D.chosenLevel 1 = _ by simp [classSum, A, N]; rfl

steps.lean:

    n] at hd hr E

steps.claim: Chain hd, hr, h, the ratio identity ratio_eq_intAlgPart_div for q₂ and the inner product with the trivial lift (inner_trivialLift).
steps.lean:
grw [hd, hr, h, ratio_eq_intAlgPart_div H₂.2, Pair.trivialLift, inner_smul_right,
    ← inner_conj_symm, inner_trivialLift _ z]

steps.claim: Express everything through the class sums and E (theta_eq_inner_kernelForm, degrees).
steps.lean:
simp [map_classSum, hα, theta_eq_inner_kernelForm, division_def, ← mul_classSum, ← classSum_mul,
    α.degree_eq_sum, sum_prod_type, eq_div_of_mul_eq (by simp [N]) (E _)]

steps.lean:
